methodology: Verified against live repo at HEAD c6b24706. All findings are evidence-backed.

root_causes.title: TC-GUARD-001 gap_ledger_ref bypass allows product sprints with zero spec authority
root_causes.observed_symptoms: Product sprints with only gap_ledger_ref and no spec_fact_refs pass TC-GUARD-001 and achieve ACCEPTED verdict
root_causes.actual_root_cause: TC-GUARD-001 in autonomous_cycle.py Step 2d3 accepts ANY of {gap_ledger_ref, capability_ref, spec_fact_refs} — gap_ledger_ref alone satisfies the gate. The OR logic was designed to be inclusive but creates a structural bypass of spec authority.
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: TC-GUARD-001 was added 2026-06-18 as a governance gate, but its OR logic means spec authority is never the sole enforcer. Every product sprint that has a gap ledger entry can bypass spec authority entirely.
affected_formats: ALL FORMATS with gap ledger entries
root_causes.blast_radius: All product sprints that use gap_ledger_ref
root_causes.current_controls: TC-GUARD-001 blocks if ALL THREE of gap_ledger_ref/capability_ref/spec_fact_refs are absent
root_causes.missing_controls: No gate requires spec_fact_refs when gap_ledger_ref is present. spec_fact_refs is advisory when gap_ledger_ref exists.
root_causes.repair_design: Change OR to AND: require BOTH gap_ledger_ref AND (spec_fact_refs OR exception_classification). Items with no_public_spec/schema_authority exception are exempt. Items with gap_ledger_ref but no spec_fact_refs and no exception fail TC-GUARD-001.
root_causes.verification_design: Add test: declaration with gap_ledger_ref and no spec_fact_refs/exception fails TC-GUARD-001 for PRODUCT_SOURCE item. Add test: same declaration with exception_classification='no_public_spec_available' passes.

root_causes.title: Evidence declaration required fields do not include spec_fact_refs — any sprint achieves ACCEPTED with zero spec citations
root_causes.observed_symptoms: Recent product sprint declarations (e.g. zst-frame-count-coverage-20260622) have spec_fact_refs=None and are ACCEPTED. supervisor-worker-contract.md required fields do not include spec_fact_refs.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: The supervisor-worker-contract.md required field list was defined before the spec authority layer was integrated. spec_fact_refs is validated by V13 when present but is not REQUIRED by the contract. A worker that never provides spec_fact_refs will never trigger V13.
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: V13 (validate_spec_fact_refs_wired) in governance_validators.py has blocks_sprint=True — but it only fires if spec_fact_refs is PROVIDED AND INVALID. If spec_fact_refs is ABSENT (None or missing), V13 does not fire at all unless the item has no exception_classification.
root_causes.blast_radius: 100% of product sprints that do not provide spec_fact_refs
root_causes.current_controls: V13 fires if spec_fact_refs is provided with invalid FACT-* IDs. sprint_executor_validate.py --repair checks schema.
root_causes.missing_controls: No validation requires spec_fact_refs to be present (not None) for PRODUCT_SOURCE items without exception_classification.
root_causes.repair_design: Add spec_fact_refs to required-or-explain fields in supervisor-worker-contract.md. Add to sprint_executor_validate.py schema check: PRODUCT_SOURCE items without exception_classification must have spec_fact_refs list with at least one FACT-* entry.
root_causes.verification_design: Add test: sprint_executor_validate.py rejects PRODUCT_SOURCE item with spec_fact_refs=None and no exception_classification. Add test: same with exception_classification='no_public_spec_available' passes.

root_causes.title: product_task_selector.py checks poc-targets.yaml membership only, not actual P-level — hard-coded task catalog bypasses authority
root_causes.observed_symptoms: product_task_selector.py emits tasks for Gnumeric (P1) and ABW (P1) from a hard-coded catalog. _get_format_authority_status() returns 'ALLOWED' for any poc-targets-registered format regardless of P-level.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: _get_format_authority_status() only checks whether the format name appears in poc-targets.yaml. It never calls authority_gate_validation.py to check actual P-level. The _BLOCKED_AUTHORITY_STATES frozenset is defined but never populated from actual P-level data. The task catalog is hard-coded with pre-approved tasks for Gnumeric and ABW.
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: The function was written with the assumption that poc-targets.yaml registration implies authority approval. This conflates product registration (commercial target) with spec authority (implementation readiness).
root_causes.blast_radius: Any format in poc-targets.yaml regardless of authority level
root_causes.current_controls: None — poc-targets.yaml membership is the only gate
root_causes.missing_controls: No call to authority_gate_validation.py before emitting tasks. No P-level minimum requirement enforced.
root_causes.repair_design: Replace _get_format_authority_status() with call to authority_gate_validation.validate_format_authority(). Block task emission if authority_level_int < MIN_PRODUCT_EXPANSION_LEVEL (4) AND no exception_classification. For formats with exception (no_public_spec, schema_authority), emit tasks with mandatory exception_classification field pre-filled.
root_causes.verification_design: Add test: product_task_selector emits 0 tasks for Gnumeric (P1) when MIN_PRODUCT_EXPANSION_LEVEL=4 check is applied. Add test: tasks for Gnumeric carry exception_classification='schema_authority_available' when exception mode is enabled.

root_causes.title: generate_next_worker_prompt.py does not inject spec authority data into worker prompts
root_causes.observed_symptoms: READ_BEFORE_EXECUTION list in generate_next_worker_prompt.py includes poc-targets.yaml but not spec cache artifacts, verified facts, or requirement packs. Workers receive no spec-derived requirements.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: The worker prompt generator was designed as a gap-ledger-to-prompt pipeline. Spec authority data (FACT-* IDs, requirement packs, spec sections) was never integrated into the prompt generation path. The generator reads next-work-items.json and gap-ledger.json but not spec-cache artifacts.
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: Without spec facts in the prompt, workers cannot cite FACT-* IDs in implementation code unless they happen to know them from prior context. The spec authority chain breaks at the prompt generation stage.
root_causes.blast_radius: All product sprints — workers cannot implement spec-backed code without spec data in prompt
root_causes.current_controls: None — prompt contains no spec authority data
root_causes.missing_controls: No injection of authority_gate_validation result, top-N verified facts, or requirement pack references into prompt
root_causes.repair_design: Add spec authority section to worker prompt: (1) call authority_gate_validation.py for target format, (2) load top-10 verified facts from sal-facts-{format}.json, (3) inject as mandatory reading list with instructions to cite FACT-* IDs in implementation code and tests.
root_causes.verification_design: Add test: generated prompt for FODS contains 'FACT-FODS-' string. Add test: generated prompt for Gnumeric contains exception_classification note.

root_causes.title: authority_integration_fabric.py exists but is unwired from autonomous_cycle.py
root_causes.observed_symptoms: grep shows authority_integration_fabric.py is never imported by autonomous_cycle.py or supervisor_loop.py. No production call path reaches it.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: authority_integration_fabric.py was created as a Phase 4 integration component (per its docstring) but was never wired into the main execution loop. It imports from tools/requirements_authority/ (graph_store, coverage_evaluator, overclaim_detector) which are also unused in production.
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: The integration fabric was developed in a separate sprint without completing the final wiring step into autonomous_cycle.py Step 0. The tools/requirements_authority/ layer is also dormant.
root_causes.blast_radius: authority-integration-contract.json never generated; overclaim_detector never runs; mainstream gap queue not authority-validated
root_causes.missing_controls: No automatic authority state computation at sprint start. No overclaim detection. No staleness invalidation.
root_causes.repair_design: Add Step 0b-authority-state in autonomous_cycle.py after plan lock and before gap selection: call authority_integration_fabric.generate_authority_contract(). Store result in .local/supervisor/authority-integration-contract.json. Make result available to product task selector and prompt generator.
root_causes.verification_design: Add test: autonomous_cycle.py Step 0b generates authority-integration-contract.json. Add test: contract contains authority levels for all POC target formats.

root_causes.title: Spec acquisition, normalization, fact extraction are not registered as governed skills with transcripts
root_causes.observed_symptoms: .supervisor/skill-registry.yaml has no entries for acquire-spec-t3, normalize-spec, or extract-spec-facts. These operations are documented in tools/spec-cache/ but are manual one-time runs.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: The spec authority pipeline (acquire_spec.py → spec_normalizer.py → run_extraction_pipeline.py → spec_verifier.py) was treated as a one-time setup operation for ODF/FODS. It was never registered as a governed repeatable skill. No skill transcript mechanism exists for these operations.
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: Without governed skills, the spec acquisition process cannot be triggered from the autonomous queue, cannot produce skill transcripts, and cannot be validated for idempotency. Each new format requires manual prompt-writing rather than queue-triggered skill invocation.
affected_formats: ALL FORMATS not yet at P4+
root_causes.blast_radius: New format acquisition requires manual agent guidance for every step
root_causes.current_controls: Tools exist but are not skills
root_causes.missing_controls: No skill entries, no transcripts, no queue-triggerable commands for spec pipeline
root_causes.repair_design: Register 5 minimum skills in .supervisor/skill-registry.yaml: acquire-spec-t3, normalize-spec, extract-spec-facts, authority-gate-validation, pilot-rerun-authority. Create corresponding .claude/commands/ files. Each skill command must produce a skill transcript.
root_causes.verification_design: Run validate_skill_contracts.py after registration. Verify each skill has command file, transcript schema, and idempotency proof.

root_causes.title: Tests for P1 formats only check spec_fact_ref CLASS ATTRIBUTES, not behavioral spec-derived assertions
root_causes.observed_symptoms: tests/python/gnumeric/test_spec_compat_layer.py asserts GnumericWorkbook.spec_fact_ref == 'FACT-GNUMERIC-001' (identifier check). No test asserts that gnumeric:Workbook is the root element of a Gnumeric XML file (behavioral check from the spec). Same pattern in ABW, SYLK, DIF tests.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: For formats at P1 with only structural/metadata facts, the only testable authority claim is 'this class has this spec_fact_ref attribute'. True behavioral spec-backed tests require verified facts with specific behavioral claims, which P1 formats lack.
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: This is a downstream consequence of RCA-SPEC-CACHE-001 (insufficient facts) and RCA-SUPERVISOR-GATES-002 (exception_classification allows P1 formats to proceed). With only 3 structural facts, there are no rich behavioral claims to test.
root_causes.blast_radius: Product proof level stays at P2 for 10+ formats
root_causes.current_controls: V53 (validate_spec_qname_compliance) checks spec_qname attributes. Anti-skip Detector 19 checks ODF spec_qname_refs.
root_causes.missing_controls: No test requirement for behavioral spec-backed assertions. No negative tests proving spec-forbidden behavior fails.
root_causes.repair_design: After advancing formats to P3+ (via spec acquisition), generate behavioral tests from verified facts. For P1 formats, document that behavioral tests are blocked by fact availability. Add negative test category requirement.
root_causes.verification_design: For FODS: verify at least 1 behavioral test per verified fact group. For P1 formats: verify exception_classification is documented in test file header.

root_causes.title: Proof graphs exist only for FODS FACT-001 and ZST FACT-001 — 4986+ other FODS facts and all ODF family facts have no proof graph
root_causes.observed_symptoms: Three iterations of proof graph builders exist. Only fods-p6-proof-graph.yaml and zst-p6-proof-graph.yaml found. ODS/ODT/FODG/FODP are P5 but no proof graphs. authority_gate_validation.py returns P6 for FODS/ZST because build/ artifacts include FACT- strings.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: P6 classification in authority_gate_validation.py uses the presence of 'FACT-FORMAT-' strings in ANY file under src/python/format/ (including build/ artifacts). This creates false P6 readings for formats where the main source files have FACT- strings in build/ subdirectories but not in installed source.
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: The P6 gate was designed to check for code citations, not for comprehensive coverage. One FACT-* string in any source file (including Compat/ facades) satisfies the P6 condition. The fact_scope note in fods-p6-proof-graph.yaml confirms: 'P6 is claimed ONLY for FACT-FODS-001. Other FODS facts remain at needs_review.'
affected_formats: ALL FORMATS — proof graph coverage is 1 fact only for FODS/ZST
root_causes.blast_radius: P6 classification overstates authority coverage; product ledger shows P6 for formats with only 1/4988 facts traced
root_causes.current_controls: fact_scope note in proof graph YAML documents the limitation. workbench-report.md may note remaining debt.
root_causes.missing_controls: No check that _check_code_citations excludes build/ artifacts. No percentage-of-facts-cited metric. No requirement for minimum fact coverage percentage before P6 is claimed.
root_causes.repair_design: (1) Fix _check_code_citations to exclude build/ directories. (2) Add facts_cited_percentage metric to authority_gate_validation output. (3) Require facts_cited_percentage >= 10% for P6. (4) Create proof graphs for remaining FODS facts.
root_causes.verification_design: Add test: authority_gate_validation excludes build/ artifacts from citation check. Add test: P6 requires minimum fact citation percentage.

root_causes.title: 15+ formats have metadata-only spec cache entries (2-5 structural facts) — T3 authorization never completed for non-ODF formats
root_causes.observed_symptoms: CSV=2 facts, NDJSON=2, TOML=2, XCF=2, QOI=2, Gnumeric=3, SYLK=3, DIF=3, ABW=5 — all structural derivation only. No normalized text, no chunks, no sections for these formats.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: T3 authorization (6 conditions including legal category, redistribution, canonical URL) was completed for ODF (legal_category=1, Open Standard). For other formats, the authorization process was never run. acquire_spec.py requires T3 before live download.
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: The T3 authorization model is correct and necessary. The gap is that no one completed the T3 process for RFC4180 (CSV), spec-toml.io (TOML), qoi.phoboslab.org (QOI), or GIMP XCF docs. These are all accessible public specs that could potentially be authorized.
root_causes.blast_radius: 8+ formats stuck at P2 with no path to P4 without T3 completion
root_causes.current_controls: T3 authorization model correctly prevents unauthorized downloads
root_causes.missing_controls: No queue item or planned sprint for completing T3 for CSV/TOML/QOI/NDJSON
root_causes.repair_design: Create T3 acquisition taskcards for: CSV (RFC4180), TOML (spec-toml.io), QOI (qoi.phoboslab.org). These are legal_category=2 or 3 (permissive community). Document T3 conditions in each acquisition pack. Run acquire_spec.py --allow-network once authorized.
root_causes.verification_design: After T3 completion, run spec_normalizer.py and verify normalized artifacts appear in .local/spec-cache/{format}/. Run refresh_check.py and verify entry is not stale.

root_causes.title: AI tools exist as ai_draft but runtime enforcement that AI output cannot contaminate verified facts is not operational
root_causes.observed_symptoms: ai_evidence_critic.py, ai_implementation_designer.py exist in tools/supervisor/ but are not in the production path. validate_spec_fact_refs.py has validate_ai_fact_guard() which checks AI-extracted facts don't self-certify as verified — but this is ADVISORY in autonomous_cycle.py Step 2d4.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: The AI authority boundary (docs/governance/ai-authority-boundary.md) is policy-only. The runtime enforcement (validate_ai_fact_guard) is called as ADVISORY (print warnings only) not BLOCKING. There is no runtime check that prevents an AI-drafted fact from being committed to verified-facts.yaml with verification_status=verified.
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: The fact verification workflow (spec_verifier.py) requires human review to mark facts as verified. But if an agent writes to verified-facts.yaml directly (outside the pipeline), no gate prevents it. validate_ai_fact_guard is the intended check but runs advisory-only.
affected_formats: ALL FORMATS — any format could have AI-self-certified facts
root_causes.blast_radius: AI-self-certified facts could inflate P-level if the verification workflow is bypassed
root_causes.current_controls: validate_ai_fact_guard runs advisory. Policy docs (ai-authority-boundary.md) are clear. T3 authorization process requires human documentation.
root_causes.missing_controls: validate_ai_fact_guard should be BLOCKING (not advisory) for PRODUCT_SOURCE items. Runtime check that verified-facts.yaml changes only come from deterministic pipeline.
root_causes.repair_design: Change Step 2d4 from ADVISORY to BLOCKING for PRODUCT_SOURCE items. Add git pre-commit hook that rejects verified-facts.yaml changes not produced by spec_verifier.py pipeline.
root_causes.verification_design: Add test: declaration with AI-extracted fact marked verified fails Step 2d4 (after upgrade to blocking).

root_causes.title: Normalization pipeline tools exist and work for ODF but have never been run for accessible non-ODF formats
root_causes.observed_symptoms: .local/spec-cache/fods/1.3/normalized/ has full artifacts (text.txt, sections.jsonl, chunks.jsonl, page-map.yaml, citations.yaml). Other formats have no normalized/ directory.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: spec_normalizer.py requires a cached spec PDF or HTML. Non-ODF formats with metadata-only cache entries cannot be normalized. For formats with accessible specs (CSV=RFC4180, TOML=spec-toml.io, QOI=qoi.phoboslab.org), normalization is blocked upstream by RCA-SPEC-CACHE-001 (T3 not completed).
root_causes.why_this_is_root_cause: Downstream of spec acquisition. No normalization can occur without a cached spec file.
root_causes.blast_radius: No normalization = no chunks = no fact extraction = stuck at P2
root_causes.current_controls: Normalization pipeline is complete and proven for ODF/FODS
root_causes.missing_controls: No planned sprint to run normalization for CSV/TOML/QOI after T3 completion
root_causes.repair_design: After T3 completion (RCA-SPEC-CACHE-001 repair), run: python tools/spec-cache/spec_normalizer.py --format-id csv --version rfc4180

root_causes.title: No active retrieval layer exists — workers cannot query spec facts during execution
root_causes.observed_symptoms: docs/spec-retrieval-and-rag-policy.md describes tier-based retrieval but no active retrieval endpoint or tool exists in the production path. Workers must know fact IDs from prior context or from prompt injection (which is also absent per RCA-PROMPT-GENERATION-001).
root_causes.actual_root_cause: The retrieval layer was designed as a future phase. Current implementation relies on manual knowledge of FACT-* IDs in worker prompt context. The RAG/embedding layer described in docs/spec-retrieval-strategy.md was never implemented.
root_causes.blast_radius: Workers must know spec facts from prompt context or prior knowledge
root_causes.current_controls: Prompt injection (when implemented per RCA-PROMPT-GENERATION-001 repair) would partially address this
root_causes.missing_controls: No query API for spec facts during execution
root_causes.repair_design: Phase E: After prompt injection is working, add simple lexical retrieval API over sal-facts-{format}.json. No embeddings needed initially.
root_causes.verification_design: python tools/spec-cache/query_spec_facts.py --format-id fods --query 'root element' returns FACT-FODS-001

root_causes.title: session-resume.md and continuation-signal.json contain no authority readiness vector
root_causes.observed_symptoms: session-resume.md shows sprint metrics (test counts, contradictions) but no authority levels per format. check_continuation.py does not verify authority readiness before returning CONTINUE. Continuation decisions are spec-agnostic.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: The continuation signal and session resume were designed for sprint-to-sprint coordination, not spec authority tracking. Authority state lives in .local/spec-cache/ and is never summarized into the continuation signal.
root_causes.blast_radius: Continuation decisions do not account for authority readiness
root_causes.missing_controls: No authority readiness check in check_continuation.py. No authority vector in session-resume.md.
root_causes.repair_design: Add authority readiness summary to session-resume.md generator: list formats at P1/P2 with 'product_expansion_blocked'. Add advisory check in check_continuation.py: warn if target format is P1/P2 without exception.
root_causes.verification_design: session-resume.md generated for gnumeric target contains 'BLOCKED: P1 schema_authority_available'

root_causes.title: P6 classification overstates authority coverage — P6 is based on minimum viable proof (1 fact) not comprehensive coverage
root_causes.observed_symptoms: authority_gate_validation.py returns P6 for FODS despite only FACT-FODS-001 having a complete proof graph. FODS has 4988 total facts; 4987 have no proof graph. fods-p6-proof-graph.yaml itself notes: 'P6 is claimed ONLY for FACT-FODS-001. Other FODS facts remain at needs_review.'
root_causes.actual_root_cause: _check_code_citations() looks for ANY 'FACT-FORMAT-' string in source files. One string satisfies P6. Similarly, _check_test_citations() looks for ANY citation. One test file with one FACT-* reference satisfies P5. The P-level system measures presence not coverage.
root_causes.blast_radius: P6 label creates false confidence about spec authority coverage
root_causes.current_controls: fact_scope note in proof graph YAML documents the limitation
root_causes.missing_controls: No percentage-of-facts-cited metric in P-level calculation
root_causes.repair_design: Add facts_cited_count and facts_cited_percentage to authority gate output. Consider P6 only when facts_cited_percentage >= configurable threshold (start at 1%, increase over time). Report P5.x (partial P6) for current FODS state.
root_causes.verification_design: authority_gate_validation.py --format-id fods --json returns facts_cited_percentage. At threshold 1%, FODS remains P6 (FACT-FODS-001 cited). At threshold 10%, FODS downgrades to P5.

root_causes.title: V13 exception_classification bypass is correct for P1 formats but creates a systemic pattern where 15/20 formats are legitimately in exception territory
root_causes.observed_symptoms: V13 allows schema_authority_available (Gnumeric), no_public_spec_available (ABW/SYLK/DIF/TSV), and legacy_backfill (CSV/NDJSON/TOML/XCF/QOI) exceptions. 15/20 formats pass V13 without any spec_fact_refs. This is architecturally correct per design but reveals scale of the problem.
root_causes.actual_root_cause: The exception classification system is correct for formats that genuinely lack public specs. The problem is that 75% of formats are in exception territory, meaning the V13 enforcement gate applies to only 5/20 formats (FODS/FODT/ODS/ODT/ZST). The no_public_spec and schema_authority exceptions are permanent for their formats, not temporary grace periods.
root_causes.blast_radius: V13 only meaningfully enforces for ODF formats and ZST
root_causes.current_controls: Exception system is correct and documented. V13 correctly allows exceptions.
root_causes.missing_controls: No alternative enforcement for P1 formats: exception items should still require exception_classification to be EXPLICIT in the declaration item, not just absent.
root_causes.repair_design: For P1 formats with exceptions: require exception_classification to be PRESENT and VALID (not absent). An absent exception_classification for a P1 format item should fail V13 just as for P4+ formats. This prevents silent bypasses.
root_causes.verification_design: Add test: Gnumeric PRODUCT_SOURCE item with absent exception_classification fails V13. Same item with exception_classification='schema_authority_available' passes V13.
